requirements.statement: Metals (version 2) tests a sample for Lead, Cadmium at CFL, and reports one approved result for each.
requirements.source: The test, its method and its analytes

requirements.statement: Lead is reported in mg/kg, rounded to 3 significant figures; a result below the LOQ (0.1 mg/kg) is reported as "< 0.1", and below the LOD (0.05 mg/kg) as "ND".
requirements.source: Analyte Lead: unit, rounding, LOQ and LOD

requirements.statement: Cadmium is reported in mg/kg, rounded to 2 decimal places; a result below the LOQ (0.02 mg/kg) is reported as "< 0.02".
requirements.source: Analyte Cadmium: unit, rounding, LOQ and LOD

requirements.statement: Each result is compared with the sample's specification; a result outside it is reported as not conforming ("< LOQ" counts as below any limit).

Every bench step is done by a person in the step's department, recorded under their name and signed when completed (with a witness where the step needs one); a step cannot be completed with data missing; every recorded value is in the audit trail.
A different person reviews each step and approves the results before they are reported; nobody reviews work they did.
The order shows Approved once every test on it has approved results.
Weigh (Chemistry) records a weight in g for each sample and prep QC.
Dilute (Chemistry) records each sample's dilution (aliquot and diluent); the dilution factor multiplies the steps.
Read (Chemistry) records the reading in ug/L for every entry and analyte, with the raw data file.
Result calculates {read.reading} * {dil.final_volume} / {weigh.weight} / 1000; it is the test's final result.
The final result is compared with the sample's specification (in the result's unit) and stored with Conforms, Does not conform or No specification.
The order's status follows its tests: In Testing while batched, In Review when nothing is left at the bench, Approved when every test has final results.

checks.title: The samples are in the backlog and batches are made from it with the Batching step's QC
checks.procedure_text: Order and log the samples below (internal client, codes VER-...); the automated analyst makes batches from the backlog until it is empty.

checks.title: "Weigh" cannot be completed while its data are missing
checks.procedure_text: Before entering anything, try to complete Weigh (signed).

expected.text: Refused: the step cannot be completed yet

checks.title: "Weigh" is completed and signed Performed by
checks.procedure_text: Record the weights (S1 0.5, S2 0.5, S3 0.5, S4 0.5 g; prep QC as S1) and a usable balance; complete (signed).

expected.text: Completed in every batch by the Verification analyst, signed "Performed by"

checks.title: "Dilute" is completed and signed Performed by
checks.procedure_text: Record each dilution (1 + 49 for every entry); complete (signed).

expected.text: Completed in every batch by the Verification analyst, signed "Performed by"

checks.title: "Read" is completed and signed Performed by
checks.procedure_text: Enter the readings (see the inputs), the QC readings, the standards, spikes and strains the QC needs, the raw data file and a usable instrument; complete (signed).

expected.text: Completed in every batch by the Verification analyst, signed "Performed by"

checks.title: "Result" is completed and signed Performed by

expected.text: Completed in every batch by the Verification analyst, signed "Performed by"

checks.title: S1 Lead: final result 1.00, Conforms
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S1 (specification at most 10 mg/kg).

checks.title: S1 Cadmium: final result 1.00, Conforms
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S1 (specification at most 2 mg/kg).

checks.title: S2 Lead: final result < 0.1, Conforms
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S2 (specification at most 10 mg/kg).

checks.title: S2 Cadmium: final result < 0.02, Conforms
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S2 (specification at most 2 mg/kg).

checks.title: S3 Lead: final result 15.0, Does not conform
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S3 (specification at most 10 mg/kg).

checks.title: S3 Cadmium: final result 3.00, Does not conform
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S3 (specification at most 2 mg/kg).

checks.title: S4 Lead: final result ND, Conforms
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S4 (specification at most 10 mg/kg).

checks.title: S4 Cadmium: final result 1.00, Conforms
checks.procedure_text: After the approval, read the stored final result of S4 (specification at most 2 mg/kg).

checks.title: The person who did the bench work cannot review the batch
checks.procedure_text: The Verification analyst tries to approve a step in QC Review.

expected.text: Refused: someone else must review it

checks.title: The batch cannot be approved before each step is approved
checks.procedure_text: The Verification reviewer tries to approve the batch (signed) before approving the steps.

checks.title: The reviewer approves each batch and the results are stored as final, signed Reviewed by
checks.procedure_text: The Verification reviewer approves each step, accepts what needs accepting, and approves the batch (signed "Reviewed by").

expected.text: Every batch Approved by the Verification reviewer; one final result per sample and analyte

checks.title: The order shows Approved
checks.procedure_text: After the last approval, read the order's status.

checks.title: Every recorded value and signature is in the audit trail
checks.procedure_text: Count the audit entries of the values recorded in the batches, and the signatures of the completed steps.

expected.text: One audit entry by the Verification analyst for each value recorded; each completed step points to its signature
